description: Approval outcome for one publisher or placement scope inside a package–creative assignment. Used when a multi-publisher package does not have one uniform approval outcome.

allOf.description: Aggregate approval state of a creative on a specific package. Mixed publisher or placement eligibility uses partially_approved plus approval_scopes on the assignment.

enumDescriptions.approved: Creative has been approved and is eligible for delivery across the whole package–creative assignment.
enumDescriptions.partially_approved: A multi-publisher or multi-placement assignment is eligible in at least one scope but not uniformly eligible across all scopes. Inspect approval_scopes for the complete per-scope outcomes.
enumDescriptions.pending_review: Creative has been submitted and is awaiting platform review
enumDescriptions.rejected: Creative was rejected by the platform, including change requests; see rejection_reason for required fixes and re-upload via sync_creatives

allOf.title: Creative Approval Status

rejection_reason.description: Human-readable explanation when this scope is rejected.

scope.description: Publisher or placement to which this approval outcome applies.

placement_id.description: Optional placement ID within publisher_domain. Omit to scope the assertion or evaluation to all delivery for the publisher in the enclosing object.

publisher_domain.description: Domain where the publisher's adagents.json is hosted.

scope.title: Indicator Scope

title: Scoped creative approval
